# Synthetic fixtures

Create hand-authored synthetic fixtures only when a real test needs them. Document purpose, generator/source, expected scope, and whether an external contract version is required. No fixtures are included now.

Never commit patient names, DOB, contact/insurance information, notes, screenshots, Dentrix payloads, production logs, credentials, or real token mappings. Redacting a few fields or replacing an ID does not make a real record safe. Prefer generated scenario identifiers with no connection to any person or client environment.
